what: Every cattle test-split photograph the shipped Gate 1 turns away at oodMax=746.1, otherMax=0.8, inspected by eye on 2026-09-23. 6 of 611 (retention 0.9902).
why_it_matters: A wrongly rejected real animal is the worst outcome for a data-collection app. These six are the whole cost of the gate on held-out cattle, so each one is looked at rather than counted.

rejected.content: Laptop screenshot with overlay text 'INTERACTIVE DISEASE PROFILES' and a person's hand. No animal.
rejected.verdict: correct rejection -- training-data contamination (the news-screenshot class documented in MODEL_CARD.md section 6), and it carried a LESION label

rejected.content: Cartoon / emoji cow on a flat green background.
rejected.verdict: correct rejection -- not a photograph of an animal

rejected.content: Herd of roughly twenty cattle far away in a mountain pasture; no individual animal fills more than a few percent of the frame.
rejected.verdict: defensible rejection -- real cattle, but no skin is assessable at this distance; AI_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md 6.2 specified rejecting bbox < 15% of frame for exactly this reason

rejected.content: Three dairy calves wearing pink calf jackets on straw in a barn.
rejected.verdict: GENUINE LOSS -- real cattle, unusual because of the clothing; d2 747 against a threshold of 746.1. The one true false rejection in 611.

rejected.content: Fibreglass Holstein statue on the roof of a shop, with signage.
rejected.verdict: correct rejection -- not a live animal

rejected.content: An antelope (eland -- long spiral horns) standing in scrub.
rejected.verdict: correct rejection -- not a bovine at all, mislabelled in the source dataset

summary.note: Four of the six are images that should never have been in a cattle dataset. The gate is doing to the test split what MODEL_CARD.md section 10 queued as a future cleanup task for the training split.
